result.title: FM-Recon: Exploring Foundation Model Features for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction
result.summary: Foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across various medical imaging tasks, yet their potential for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, particularly within unrolled reconstruction networks and under artifact-corrupted inputs. In this work, we explore whether and how features from pretrained foundation models can benefit accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. To this end, we propose FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates extracted features from frozen image encoder of foundation models into an unrolled reconstruction network. Through extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset, we systematically evaluate foundation model features across different reconstruction settings. Our results show that foundation models can extract informative representations from artifact-corrupted inputs and improve reconstruction performance, particularly at moderate acceleration factors. These findings demonstrate the potential of foundation model features for accelerated MRI reconstruction and provide insights into their effective integration into unrolled reconstruction networks.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出 FM-Recon，将冻结的基础模型图像编码器特征经精炼后注入展开式（unrolled）重建网络，并在心脏电影 MRI 加速重建任务上系统评估不同重建设置下的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心发现是基础模型可从含伪影输入中提取有用表示，与 LVR 中「视觉证据筛选与内部表示保留」的问题可能有间接联系，可供核查冻结视觉编码特征在迭代状态更新中的增益与失效条件；但不涉及多模态推理或 latent 生成。
